body:
There's two ways of doing this. First is to have the whole Instantsearch in a div on both the home page and on the results page. It can be `[hidden]` until someone first `focus`es the input.

A second option is to make the input on the home page a `<form>` which has as action `/results` `type=get`. that can then be used on your `results` page to fill in the search bar.

Does that help you?
